sentences.text: Tiene veinticinco años y una niña pequeña.
sentences.english: He is twenty-five and has a little girl.

sentences.text: Carlos es carpintero, pero ahora no tiene empleo.
sentences.english: Carlos is a carpenter, but now he has no job.
He looks for work every day.
Today he walks to the shop.

sentences.text: Horario: de las siete a las cinco.
Sueldo: tres mil lempiras al mes.
sentences.english: Wage: three thousand lempiras a month.

sections.title: Con la señora de la pulpería

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: But today there is a notice.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Soy carpintero, pero también soy mecánico.
sentences.english: I am a carpenter, but I am also a mechanic.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Es un hombre alto y amable.
sentences.english: He is a tall and kind man.

sentences.text: Carlos vive con su esposa y su niña.
sentences.english: Carlos lives with his wife and his little girl.

sentences.text: Su esposa vende baleadas en la calle.
sentences.english: His wife sells baleadas in the street.

sentences.text: Ella agrega queso, tomate y verdura con una cuchara, y fríe la tortilla con aceite.
sentences.english: She adds cheese, tomato and vegetables with a spoon, and fries the tortilla with oil.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: I want to get the job.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Mañana es el cumpleaños de nuestra niña.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is our little girl's birthday.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Pues, mañana hablo con el jefe.
sentences.english: Well, tomorrow I talk with the boss.

sentences.text: Por la mañana, Carlos llega a la empresa.
sentences.english: In the morning, Carlos arrives at the company.

sentences.text: Los autobuses son rojos y verdes.
sentences.english: The buses are red and green.

sentences.text: El lugar es limpio, blanco y azul.
sentences.english: The place is clean, white and blue.

sentences.text: El señor es delgado y simpático.
sentences.english: The man is thin and nice.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: I am a carpenter and a mechanic.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Ayer ayudé a un señor con un autobús viejo.
sentences.english: Yesterday I helped a man with an old bus.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: How long did you work there?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Trabajé ocho meses en el negocio de un amigo.
sentences.english: I worked eight months at a friend's business.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Pero ahora el negocio no tiene dinero.
sentences.english: But now the business has no money.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Why do you want to work here?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: No quiero gastar todo el dinero.
sentences.english: I do not want to spend all the money.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: I need to save at the bank.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Tengo una cuenta, pero no tiene mucho.
sentences.english: I have an account, but it does not have much.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: ¿Puede trabajar de las siete a las cinco?
sentences.english: Can you work from seven to five?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: El sueldo es tres mil lempiras al mes.
sentences.english: The wage is three thousand lempiras a month.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: That is very good for me.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Adoro a Dios y leo la Biblia.
sentences.english: I worship God and I read the Bible.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Dios perdona a todos en el mundo.
sentences.english: God forgives everyone in the world.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Mi esposa es un ángel de Dios.
sentences.english: My wife is an angel of God.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: On Monday you work with us.

sentences.text: El lunes llega a las siete, como dice el horario.
sentences.english: On Monday he arrives at seven, as the schedule says.

sentences.text: Trabaja con otros hombres, y todos son amables.
sentences.english: He works with other men, and they are all kind.

sentences.text: Un día, Carlos quiere tener un negocio.
sentences.english: Someday, Carlos wants to have a business.

sentences.text: El autobús viejo es negro y feo, pero Carlos va a trabajar con él.
sentences.english: The old bus is black and ugly, but Carlos is going to work on it.

sentences.text: El domingo Carlos va al culto con su esposa y su niña.
sentences.english: On Sunday Carlos goes to the service with his wife and his little girl.

sentences.text: Cantan un himno y una canción.
sentences.english: They sing a hymn and a song.

sentences.text: Después del culto, el pastor habla con Carlos.
sentences.english: After the service, the pastor talks with Carlos.

sentences.speaker: Z
sentences.text: Hoy es un buen día para dar gracias.
sentences.english: Today is a good day to give thanks.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Voy a poner una ofrenda en la bolsa.
sentences.english: I am going to put an offering in the bag.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Qué bueno que ya tenés trabajo.
sentences.english: How good that you have work now.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Of course, I will gladly come.

sentences.text: Al fin del mes, Carlos tiene su primer sueldo.
sentences.english: At the end of the month, Carlos has his first wage.

sentences.text: Primero paga la comida y la casa.
sentences.english: First he pays for the food and the house.

sentences.text: Luego va al banco con su esposa.
sentences.english: Then he goes to the bank with his wife.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Queremos poner dinero en una cuenta.
sentences.english: We want to put money in an account.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: Do you have an account at the bank?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: It is for the little girl.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Now we are going to spend less.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: It is very good to save.

sentences.text: Carlos y su esposa salen de allí.
Carlos lleva pan y un regalo para su niña.
sentences.english: Carlos takes bread and a present for his little girl.

sentences.text: Su casa es pequeña, pero es bonita.
sentences.english: Their house is small, but it is pretty.

sentences.text: En la casa, la familia celebra el cumpleaños de la niña.
sentences.english: At home, the family celebrates the little girl's birthday.
